question: ¿Cuántos ensayos que prueban pembrolizumab están activos, es decir reclutando, activos sin reclutar, todavía sin reclutar o por invitación?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE s.overall_status IN ('RECRUITING','ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING','NOT_YET_RECRUITING','ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.interventions i WHERE i.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (lower(i.name) LIKE '%pembrolizumab%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%keytruda%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%mk-3475%'))
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.intervention_other_names o WHERE o.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (lower(o.name) LIKE '%pembrolizumab%' OR lower(o.name) LIKE '%keytruda%' OR lower(o.name) LIKE '%mk-3475%')))
